title: Recording leaked to Globo and the case ridiculed

tellings.quote: it, he leaked the recording at the time to a TV network called Globu in Brazil. And this network every time would ridicule the case,

plain: Carlos Dosoza, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about the 1996 case of beings said to have been captured in Brazil, says a recording about the case was leaked to Globo, a big Brazilian TV network. He says the network, on a show he calls Fantas, would ridicule the case every time, and he names a Claudia Kovu. He tells it to explain how the case was made to look foolish to the public.
